# Period vs group

```{r}
ggplot(cov, aes(x = period, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(title = "Period by group", 
       x = "period", 
       y = "group of stat",
       fill = "Charlson") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "YlOrRd") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )
```
# Cox model: ICU 

```{r}
load("~/Documents/2025-2026/second semester/tfg/datos_tfg/DataReinfection.RData")
icu<-bbdd4cr
```

```{r}
# Cox model for reinfection (event = 1)
causmod1 <- coxph(Surv(stime0, delta == 1) ~ sex + age + charlson + quintil + hsptime + icutime, 
                  data = icu)

label<- c(
  sexMujer      = "Sex (female)",
  age      = "Age (years)",
  charlson = "CCI",
  quintil  = "Socioeconomic Quintile",
  hsptime  = "Hospital Stay (days)",
  icutime  = "ICU Stay (days)"
)

# Extract results
resultados    <- tidy(causmod1, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = FALSE)
resultados_hr <- tidy(causmod1, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)

# Apply custom labels (falls back to original term if label not found)
noms <- ifelse(resultados$term %in% names(label),
               label[resultados$term],
               resultados$term)

# Create custom table
tabla_cox <- data.frame(
  Variable = noms,
  Beta     = round(resultados$estimate, 3),
  SE       = round(resultados$std.error, 3),
  HR       = round(resultados_hr$estimate, 3),
  CI_lower = round(resultados_hr$conf.low, 3),
  CI_upper = round(resultados_hr$conf.high, 3),
  Z_stat   = round(resultados$statistic, 2),
  p_value  = ifelse(resultados$p.value < 0.001, "<0.001",
                    round(resultados$p.value, 3))
)

# Display table
kable(tabla_cox,
      caption = "Cox Model for COVID-19: ICU Reinfection",
      align   = c('l', rep('c', 7)),
      col.names = c("Variable", "Est.", "SE", "HR", "CI Low", "CI Up", "Z", "p"),
      format  = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "scale_down"),
                position   = "center",
                font_size  = 9,
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "4cm") %>%
  column_spec(2:8, width = "1.3cm") %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 3, "HR (95% CI)" = 3, " " = 2)) %>%
  footnote(general = paste("n =", causmod1$n,
                           "; Events =", causmod1$nevent,
                           "; C-index =", round(summary(causmod1)$concordance[1], 2)),
           threeparttable = TRUE)
```
just hospital time
```{r}
library(broom)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(survival)

causmod1 <- coxph(Surv(stime0, delta == 1) ~ sex + age + charlson + quintil + hsptime, 
                  data = icu)

label<- c(
  sexMujer      = "Sex (female)",
  age      = "Age (years)",
  charlson = "CCI",
  quintil  = "Socioeconomic Quintile",
  hsptime  = "Hospital Stay (days)"
)

# Extract results
resultados    <- tidy(causmod1, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = FALSE)
resultados_hr <- tidy(causmod1, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)

# Apply custom labels (falls back to original term if label not found)
noms <- ifelse(resultados$term %in% names(label),
               label[resultados$term],
               resultados$term)

# Create custom table
tabla_cox <- data.frame(
  Variable = noms,
  Beta     = round(resultados$estimate, 3),
  SE       = round(resultados$std.error, 3),
  HR       = round(resultados_hr$estimate, 3),
  CI_lower = round(resultados_hr$conf.low, 3),
  CI_upper = round(resultados_hr$conf.high, 3),
  Z_stat   = round(resultados$statistic, 2),
  p_value  = ifelse(resultados$p.value < 0.001, "<0.001",
                    round(resultados$p.value, 3))
)

# Display table
kable(tabla_cox,
      #caption = "Cox Model for COVID-19: ICU Reinfection",
      align   = c('l', rep('c', 7)),
      col.names = c("Variable", "Est.", "SE", "HR", "CI Low", "CI Up", "Z", "p"),
      format  = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "scale_down"),
                position   = "center",
                font_size  = 9,
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "4cm") %>%
  column_spec(2:8, width = "1.3cm") %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 3, "HR (95% CI)" = 3, " " = 2)) %>%
  footnote(general = paste("n =", causmod1$n,
                           "; Events =", causmod1$nevent,
                           "; C-index =", round(summary(causmod1)$concordance[1], 2)),
           threeparttable = TRUE)
```

## Reinfection

```{r}
# Cox model for reinfection (event = 1)
causmod1 <- coxph(Surv(stime0, delta == 1) ~ sex + age + charlson + quintil + hsptime+polimed, 
                  data = hospital)

label<- c(
  sexFemale      = "Sex (female)",
  age      = "Age (years)",
  charlson = "CCI",
  quintil  = "Socioeconomic Quintile",
  hsptime  = "Hospital Stay (days)",
  polimed  = "Polymedication (yes)"
)

# Extract results
resultados    <- tidy(causmod1, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = FALSE)
resultados_hr <- tidy(causmod1, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)

# Apply custom labels (falls back to original term if label not found)
noms <- ifelse(resultados$term %in% names(label),
               label[resultados$term],
               resultados$term)

# Create custom table
tabla_cox <- data.frame(
  Variable = noms,
  Beta     = round(resultados$estimate, 3),
  SE       = round(resultados$std.error, 3),
  HR       = round(resultados_hr$estimate, 3),
  CI_lower = round(resultados_hr$conf.low, 3),
  CI_upper = round(resultados_hr$conf.high, 3),
  Z_stat   = round(resultados$statistic, 2),
  p_value  = ifelse(resultados$p.value < 0.001, "<0.001",
                    round(resultados$p.value, 3))
)

# Display table
kable(tabla_cox,
      caption = "Cox Model for COVID-19: Hospital Reinfection",
      align   = c('l', rep('c', 7)),
      col.names = c("Variable", "Est.", "SE", "HR", "CI Low", "CI Up", "Z", "p"),
      format  = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "scale_down"),
                position   = "center",
                font_size  = 9,
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "4cm") %>%
  column_spec(2:8, width = "1.3cm") %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 3, "HR (95% CI)" = 3, " " = 2)) %>%
  footnote(general = paste("n =", causmod1$n,
                           "; Events =", causmod1$nevent,
                           "; C-index =", round(summary(causmod1)$concordance[1], 2)),
           threeparttable = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Extract results
resultados    <- tidy(causmod1, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = FALSE)
resultados_hr <- tidy(causmod1, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)

# Apply custom labels (falls back to original term if label not found)
noms <- ifelse(resultados$term %in% names(label),
               label[resultados$term],
               resultados$term)

# Create custom table
tabla_cox <- data.frame(
  Variable = noms,
  Beta     = round(resultados$estimate, 3),
  SE       = round(resultados$std.error, 3),
  HR       = round(resultados_hr$estimate, 3),
  CI_lower = round(resultados_hr$conf.low, 3),
  CI_upper = round(resultados_hr$conf.high, 3),
  Z_stat   = round(resultados$statistic, 2),
  p_value  = ifelse(resultados$p.value < 0.001, "<0.001",
                    round(resultados$p.value, 3))
)

# Display table
kable(tabla_cox,
      caption = "Cox Model for COVID-19: Home Death",
      align   = c('l', rep('c', 7)),
      col.names = c("Variable", "Est.", "SE", "HR", "CI Low", "CI Up", "Z", "p"),
      format  = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "scale_down"),
                position   = "center",
                font_size  = 9,
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "4cm") %>%
  column_spec(2:8, width = "1.3cm") %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 3, "HR (95% CI)" = 3, " " = 2)) %>%
  footnote(general = paste("n =", causmod1$n,
                           "; Events =", causmod1$nevent,
                           "; C-index =", round(summary(causmod1)$concordance[1], 2)),
           threeparttable = TRUE)
```

# Cox model

## Reinfection


```{r}
causmod1 <- coxph(Surv(stime0, delta == 1) ~ sex + age + charlson + quintil + polimed + factor(group),
                  data = cov)

etiquetes <- c(
  "sexFemale"                  = "Sex (female)",
  "age"                        = "Age (years)",
  "charlson"                   = "CCI",
  "quintil"                    = "Socioeconomic Quintile",
  "polimed"                    = "Polymedication (yes)",
  "factor(group)Hosp.(No ICU)" = "Group: Hospital (No ICU)",
  "factor(group)ICU"           = "Group: ICU"
)

# Extract results
resultados    <- tidy(causmod1, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = FALSE)
resultados_hr <- tidy(causmod1, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)

# Apply custom labels (falls back to original term if label not found)
noms <- ifelse(resultados$term %in% names(etiquetes),
               etiquetes[resultados$term],
               resultados$term)

# Create custom table
tabla_cox <- data.frame(
  Variable = noms,
  Beta     = round(resultados$estimate, 3),
  SE       = round(resultados$std.error, 3),
  HR       = round(resultados_hr$estimate, 3),
  CI_lower = round(resultados_hr$conf.low, 3),
  CI_upper = round(resultados_hr$conf.high, 3),
  Z_stat   = round(resultados$statistic, 2),
  p_value  = ifelse(resultados$p.value < 0.001, "<0.001",
                    round(resultados$p.value, 3))
)

# Display table
kable(tabla_cox,
      caption   = "Cox Model for COVID-19 Reinfection",
      align     = c('l', rep('c', 7)),
      col.names = c("Variable", "Est.", "SE", "HR", "CI Low", "CI Up", "Z", "p"),
      format    = "latex",
      booktabs  = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "scale_down"),
                position   = "center",
                font_size  = 9,
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "4.5cm") %>%
  column_spec(2:8, width = "1.3cm") %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 3, "HR (95% CI)" = 3, " " = 2)) %>%
  footnote(general = paste("n =", causmod1$n,
                           "; Events =", causmod1$nevent,
                           "; C-index =", round(summary(causmod1)$concordance[1], 2)),
           threeparttable = TRUE)
```
